overview_description.description: Noon Academy is the leading edtech platform in the Middle East, having taught 12 million students. We have recently raised $41 million in Series B funding to expand our reach and impact in the region and beyond. We focus on making learning fun and engaging, both online, and in physical classrooms. Our ultimate goal is to provide access to the best teachers to every student even if that teacher is only available virtually. We believe we can do this if we blend AI, peer-to-peer learning, and a carefully designed physical space.

product.name: Noon Platform
product.description: A cloud-based social learning platform enabling students to access live and recorded educational courses from educators worldwide.

product.name: Educator Services
product.description: Services enabling educators to create, manage, and deliver online courses to students via the Noon Platform.

product.name: Student Learning Experience
product.description: Interactive learning features for students including live classes, group study, quizzes, and real-time question answering.

product.name: Payment and Refund Management
product.description: A system managing payments to educators and refunds to students for courses purchased on the Noon Platform.

product.name: Technical and Customer Support
product.description: Support services providing technical assistance and customer service to students and educators using the Noon Platform.
